passages.label: Senza alcun ordine la danza sia … farai ballar

licences.notes: Words as printed in the Schirmer vocal score (menuetto, l'alemana where the libretto has l'alemanna, folia once for follia, fa for fa'; bar 134 prints de-vi_aum-tar, kept as devi aumentar).

licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), pages 100–104, bars 1–160 of No. 11
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung line and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar and checked again by a fresh checker. The English singing translation is left out; Leporello is on stage but does not sing. The piano's held chords in bars 87–114 are written as printed (F, C, E-flat over the bass). Playback tempo: a half note = 116 (♩ = 232), about 1:23, the median of five complete recordings (Fricsay 1958 1:18, Giulini 1959 1:23, C. Davis 1973 1:32, Böhm 1977 1:44, Karajan 1985 1:21); Mozart gives the word Presto only.
